headline: Fed Chair Warsh: no tolerating inflation 'somewhere in the *twos*'
quote: We doubled down on the 2% inflation target. We said, we own it.
title: Fed Chair Warsh: "We own" the 2% inflation target
caption: October 28, 2026 press conference: Chair Kevin Warsh says the Fed won't settle for inflation "somewhere in the twos".
